Team / Sarah,

Quick note as we enter the final 48 hours of Q3 close: we need a short hygiene sweep to make sure the ACME opportunity is staged correctly and finance has what they need to book. Action items below — please reply inline with confirmations.

1) Stage pruning: set opportunity stage to "Commit - Legal/PO pending" only if we have a signed PO or DocuSign envelope executed. If no signed PO, keep stage at "Contract" and flag as "commit at-risk."

2) Final commit numbers: Sarah — can you confirm the finalized ARR and start date that Procurement expects on the PO? We need a single committed ARR line to pass to Finance (no split lines).

3) Billing cadence & billing contacts: Procurement, please confirm billing contact and expected net terms (Net 30 / Net 45).

4) Attachments: I'm adding a one-tab rollup (Q3_commit_rollup_template.xlsx) — please fill the final committed ARR and attach PO when available.

Timeline: if we have a signed PO by 1800 PT tomorrow (2026-09-14), Finance will accept this as a Q3 close and will book to 09/30/2026. If PO comes in after that, we'll table for next quarter unless leadership approves override.

Thanks — Kimberly
